_about: The Emperor's Diary (EN) — fixed character → Typecast voice mapping for all English episodes (owner 2026-11-11 01:55 KST: narrator Ron, Marcus Aurelius Robert slower). Keep the same mapping for future episodes; add new recurring characters here.

M.role: Marcus Aurelius (emperor's own lines and Meditations quotes)
M.name: Robert
M.note: owner 2026-11-11 10:08: Robert 1.0 confirmed (round-3 comparison; sample docs/emperor/long/en/samples/voice_emperor_v2RobertNormal.mp3). Emotional lines may use sad 1.3.

V.role: Roman general / officer / messenger (e.g. Martius Verus)
V.name: Carl
V.note: middle-aged, clear, urgent soldier; distinct from Ron's bass and Robert's age

C.name: Rusty
C.note: husky bass, hard; used for shouted declarations

W.role: women (e.g. empress Faustina) — to be chosen when an English episode first needs a female speaking line
